data.name: Iniat
data.gender_notes: Iniat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'in'a' which means 'new' and 'at' which means 'beginning'. It signifies the start of something new and innovative. The name Iniat carries the meaning “New Beginning, Innovation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Iniat usually hope their child will grow to embody new beginning, innovation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the start of a spiritual journey or the beginning of a new phase in one's spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Iniat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “New Beginning, Innovation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iniat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
